result.summary: Overall layout looks mostly clean; one minor styling inconsistency was found with the heart/favorite icon contrast on the pizza card.

issues.description: The heart icon on the pizza promo card (bottom) is dark/black on a dark wood background, giving it low contrast and making it slightly hard to see compared to the white heart icon used on the Ramen card.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent white or high-contrast heart icon style across all restaurant cards regardless of background image.
